name: data-pandas
description: Manipulate tabular data with pandas: loading, cleaning, joins, groupby, reshaping. Use for pandas/.csv/.parquet analysis in Python.
pitfalls: Loading huge CSVs whole instead of chunking

name: data-numpy
description: Compute with NumPy arrays: vectorization, broadcasting, dtypes, memory layout. Use for numerical array work in Python.
checklist: dtype and memory layout chosen deliberately

name: data-polars
description: Use Polars for fast, memory-efficient dataframes with lazy execution. Use for large tabular data in Python/Rust.
checklist: Lazy API used for query optimization
pitfalls: Falling back to Python UDFs and losing speed
Collecting too early in lazy pipelines

name: data-science-eda
description: Perform exploratory data analysis: distributions, missingness, correlations, outliers, leakage checks. Use before modeling.

name: data-cleaning
description: Clean and validate messy data: types, duplicates, missing values, encodings, schema validation. Use when preparing raw data.

name: data-visualization
description: Visualize data effectively (matplotlib/seaborn/plotly): right chart, honest axes, accessible color. Use when charting data.

name: data-etl-pipelines
description: Build ETL/ELT pipelines: extract, transform, load, idempotency, incremental processing. Use when moving/transforming data between systems.

name: data-warehousing
description: Model analytical warehouses (Snowflake/BigQuery/Redshift): star schema, partitioning, clustering, cost. Use for warehouse design/queries.
pitfalls: No partitioning on large fact tables

name: data-spark
description: Process big data with Apache Spark (PySpark/Scala): DataFrames, partitions, shuffles, joins. Use for large-scale distributed data. Detect spark first.
pitfalls: Data skew stalling a few tasks
Collecting large results to the driver (OOM)

name: data-airflow
description: Orchestrate data workflows with Apache Airflow/Prefect/Dagster: DAGs, scheduling, retries, backfills. Use for pipeline orchestration.

name: data-dbt
description: Transform warehouse data with dbt: models, tests, sources, incremental materializations. Use for dbt projects.

name: data-streaming
description: Build streaming data pipelines (Kafka Streams/Flink/Spark Streaming): windowing, exactly-once, state. Use for realtime data processing.

name: data-feature-engineering
description: Engineer features for ML: encoding, scaling, aggregation, leakage-free transforms, feature stores. Use when preparing model inputs.
checklist: Transforms fit on train only (no leakage)
pitfalls: Fitting scalers/encoders on the full dataset (leakage)

name: ml-scikit-learn
description: Build classical ML with scikit-learn: pipelines, cross-validation, metrics, model selection. Use for tabular ML in Python.
pitfalls: Overfitting to the test set via tuning

name: ml-pytorch
description: Build and train neural networks with PyTorch: tensors, autograd, modules, training loops, GPU. Use for PyTorch models. Detect torch first.
checklist: Tensors/devices consistent (all on GPU or CPU)

name: ml-tensorflow
description: Build and train models with TensorFlow/Keras: layers, tf.data, training, SavedModel. Use for TF/Keras models. Detect tensorflow first.

name: ml-training-pipeline
description: Design reproducible training pipelines: data splits, seeds, checkpoints, early stopping, logging. Use when training models seriously.

name: ml-evaluation
description: Evaluate models rigorously: right metrics, baselines, confidence, error analysis, fairness. Use when judging model quality.

name: ml-hyperparameter-tuning
description: Tune hyperparameters efficiently: grid/random/Bayesian search, cross-validation, avoiding overfit-to-val. Use when optimizing models.
checklist: Nested CV or a held-out test
Best config validated on unseen data

name: ml-model-serving
description: Serve ML models in production: batch vs online, latency, versioning, monitoring, rollback. Use when deploying models.

name: ml-mlops
description: Operationalize ML: data/model versioning, CI for models, reproducibility, monitoring, retraining. Use for production ML systems.

name: ml-experiment-tracking
description: Track ML experiments (MLflow/W&B): params, metrics, artifacts, comparisons, reproducibility. Use when running many experiments.
pitfalls: Logging metrics but not the code/data version

name: nlp-fundamentals
description: Process natural language: tokenization, embeddings, classification, NER, evaluation. Use for text/NLP tasks.
pitfalls: Leakage from duplicate texts across splits

name: computer-vision
description: Build computer vision models: augmentation, transfer learning, detection/segmentation, evaluation. Use for image tasks.
pitfalls: Wrong normalization for a pretrained model

name: timeseries-forecasting
description: Forecast time series: stationarity, seasonality, backtesting, classical vs ML models. Use for forecasting tasks.

name: recommender-systems
description: Build recommenders: collaborative/content filtering, ranking, cold start, offline/online eval. Use for recommendation features.

name: llm-prompting
description: Engineer effective LLM prompts: clear instructions, examples, structure, output constraints, evaluation. Use when building LLM features.
pitfalls: Vague prompts with no output contract

name: llm-rag
description: Build retrieval-augmented generation: chunking, embeddings, vector search, reranking, grounding. Use for RAG systems.

name: llm-embeddings
description: Use text/vector embeddings: models, similarity, vector databases, indexing, hybrid search. Use for semantic search/RAG.
pitfalls: Mismatched embedding model at query vs index time

name: llm-fine-tuning
description: Fine-tune or adapt LLMs (LoRA/PEFT): data prep, training, evaluation, when NOT to fine-tune. Use when adapting models.
pitfalls: No eval vs the base model

name: llm-agents
description: Build LLM agents/tool-use systems: tool definitions, loops, guardrails, budgets, evaluation. Use when building agentic workflows.
checklist: Untrusted tool output treated as data, not instructions
pitfalls: No evaluation of end-to-end task success

name: llm-evaluation
description: Evaluate LLM outputs: golden sets, LLM-as-judge, rubrics, regression tests, hallucination checks. Use to measure LLM quality.
checklist: Golden/eval set representative of real use

name: ai-api-integration
description: Integrate hosted AI APIs (Claude, OpenAI, etc.): auth, streaming, retries, cost, rate limits, caching. Use when calling AI provider APIs.
pitfalls: API keys in client code or repos

name: jupyter-notebooks
description: Use Jupyter notebooks well: reproducible order, cleared outputs in VCS, kernel hygiene, promotion to scripts. Use for .ipynb work.
checklist: Production code moved out of notebooks

name: statistics-fundamentals
description: Apply core statistics: sampling, hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, p-values, common fallacies. Use when reasoning about data/experiments.
